source.author: verg
source.text: Armipotens, praeses belli, Tritonia virgo, frange manu telum Phrygii praedonis et ipsum pronum sterne solo portisque effunde sub altis.
source.text_original: 'Armipotens, praeses belli, Tritonia virgo, / frange manu telum Phrygii praedonis et ipsum / pronum sterne solo portisque effunde sub altis.'
source.text_english: Mighty in arms, guardian of war, Tritonian maiden, break with your hand the weapon of the Phrygian plunderer and lay him himself low, face down, upon the ground, and pour him out beneath the lofty gates.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: in moenia pernix Thespia et ad carum Tritonia devolat Argum.
reuse.text_original: in moenia pernix / Thespia et ad carum Tritonia devolat Argum.
reuse.text_english: Swift Thespia flies down to the walls, and Tritonia to dear Argus.
